g.text: FIG 1 PLAN AND LONGITUDINAL SECTION - SAMPLE FLOW PATH
ALL DIMENSIONS IN MILLIMETRES - GEOMETRY GENERATED FROM mechanical/constants.py
Three dia6 nostrils, front wall - sample entry
Cleanable woven PTFE mesh filter, front drawer
Eight identical keyed 1x6 OSM-1 gas-cell sockets

USB-C power and data; no battery in the gas path
